note: Three Upgrade Roadmap 2 heat, hot water and shelter-efficiency systems. Existing workbook numbers are unchanged. Heat-need reductions are engine modifiers in catalog_overrides.json; all quantities are labeled game assumptions in row notes.

systems.name: Canvas Tent Winter Liner
systems.description: An insulated inner liner hung inside a canvas tent or yurt; a cheap step before a bigger heater.
systems.notes: Place it on the canvas shelter it lines: that shelter's heat need x 0.75. Liner insulation value and lifespan are experimental game assumptions.

systems.name: Wood Boiler with Water Jacket
systems.description: A wood stove with a water jacket and tank: heat in winter and hot water all year from firewood.
systems.notes: 50 lb Woody biomass/week, fired year-round -> 150,000 BTU/week Heat (heating season) + 140 gal/week Hot water. Summer firing for hot water gives heat nobody needs. Efficiency and split are experimental game assumptions.

systems.name: Draft-Proofing Kit (small shelter)
systems.description: Weatherstripping, caulk and door sweeps for a tiny house, camper, cabin or dome.
systems.notes: Place it on a small hard shelter (camper, camper van, solar cabin, tiny house, container, earthbag dome, treehouse): heat need x 0.85, cooling need x 0.9. Overlaps the whole-house weatherization retrofit; the game multiplies them. Values are experimental game assumptions.
